caption:
Holidays over, and Koko is back at exercise class. She did her usual routine, and the next morning her legs felt worse.

Two weeks off usually costs very little strength or fitness. What changes is how your body tolerates load, which is why the first sessions back can feel harder than expected.

Try starting at about half your usual volume, then build over two to three weeks. Use the next-morning test: mild soreness that eases is fine, soreness that's worse is a cue to hold. And change one thing at a time in the new year rush.

Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help plan your return. Book online via the link in bio.
